job:
DevOps Engineer

We're seeking an experienced DevOps Engineer to join our platform team at StreamCore Technologies. You'll be responsible for building and maintaining scalable cloud infrastructure that supports our growing microservices architecture. This role involves working with containerized applications, managing infrastructure as code, and ensuring reliable deployment pipelines. You'll be part of a collaborative team focused on operational excellence and continuous improvement.

Must-have:

- Hands-on experience with Kubernetes (container orchestration, cluster management)
- Proficiency with Terraform or equivalent infrastructure-as-code tools
- Strong CI/CD pipeline experience (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or similar)
- Demonstrated cloud platform experience with AWS or GCP
- Experience implementing and maintaining monitoring and alerting systems (Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch)

Nice-to-have:

- Experience managing production incidents and on-call responsibilities
- Multi-cloud or multi-region infrastructure deployment
- Experience with advanced observability and tracing tools
- Contribution to open-source infrastructure projects
